guidance: Based on current projected borrowing needs, Treasury anticipates maintaining nominal coupon and FRN auction sizes for the next several quarters.

Looking ahead, Treasury continues to evaluate potential future changes to nominal coupon and FRN auction sizes, with a focus on trends in structural demand and potential costs and risks of various issuance profiles.

Based on current forecasts, Treasury expects to maintain current auction sizes of benchmark bills into late November and anticipates potentially issuing a short-dated CMB to meet its cash management needs around the end of November.
